results.title: The session's Shared tab
results.checks: The host starts a session in John 3 and a guest joins: that tab is marked Shared with the people on it (Host first); its ⋮ has Session settings, Share session and Open chat instead of Save. A new tab moved to Romans 8 does not move the session (the guest stays in John 3). Closing the Shared tab from its ⋮ ends the session for the guest
results.note: the session's tab showed Shared with its people and the session menu; another tab left the guest in John 3; closing the tab ended it

results.title: Who is here, on a phone
results.checks: The host starts a session on a computer; a guest joins on a phone: the chapter's top bar shows a stack of faces (2 people); a tap opens the Participants sheet with the host marked Host and the guest marked (you), and its Session settings opens the settings window
results.note: the phone's top bar showed 2 faces; the sheet named the Host and the guest (you); Session settings opened

results.title: A phone: the old reader's phone shell
results.checks: On an iPhone 13: a thin bar at the top (the translation, then ☆, bookmark, share and text settings), the chapter's title centred and large (John over a big 3), and along the bottom play and the chapter pill ‹ John 3 › above the five tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More, with Bible lit. The pill's › goes to John 4 and its label opens the book picker; Bible on the text opens it too. More → Tabs opens the Tabs drawer, which closes with its ✕ and with a tap beside it; reading down scrolls the page itself; signed out, You carries the count of changes waiting and opens the sign-in pane
results.note: top bar: 5 buttons; title "John 3"; tabs Today · You · Bible · Search · More; › and the pill and Bible worked; the Tabs drawer closed by ✕ and by a tap beside it; the page scrolled; You carried the waiting count and opened sign-in
